items.title: Curtis Mitchell Interview, 1996-04-02
items.q: after I finished that gig with Montra... during the time when I was playing with Montra

ctx.x: Yeah. Was that the, I want to ask you something. How long did it take you like, when you were playing, to get proficient to where you felt like you really, you felt like you were a real bass player? Yeah. You must have taken your own.

Yeah, well after I, see I never took bass at Greenwald School. Yeah, mostly self-taught there, you know. So what happened, after I finished that gig with Montra, Texas Lodge, I went on the road. But I didn't go out there playing bass. I went out there playing piano with Clyde and them, you know. And then when I come back, well, during the time when I was playing with Montra, I already had bought a book, you know, and the bass. So when I come back I went to practicing out the book, you know, and I learned how to…
So you think you taught yourself correctly?
